title: Close common Gallery runtime boundary
requires: Linux desktop with one Gallery backend
scope: Remove the remaining desktop-private frame coordinator and mutable runtime escape hatch so desktop and mobile ordinary frames use one GallerySession orchestration contract.
acceptance: Desktop and mobile ordinary interactive frames use the same GallerySession stepping, timing and renderer handoff; platform shells do not own a second fixed-step policy or call controlled_step directly.

Platform clients cannot mutate GalleryRuntime internals through GallerySession; typed rendering, capture, calibration and diagnostic interfaces retain current desktop behavior and pass common-session plus desktop backend tests.
